summary: The player-facing shell is built and committed on wt/ui. Eight in-game suites pass (151 checks, no red errors; last run ui6), and the 1.7 build is clean. The Hearth & Harbor main tab, with its guests page and income overview, only appears once the colony has a venue, a bank account, a guest or a guest bed. Pawns who are guests get a Guest tab with stay info, satisfaction reasons, budget and a Basics/Accompany/Recruit selector. The settings window is rebuilt with a sidebar, a this-save/template switch, a difficulty page with live numbers, and diagnosis and removal tools. A first-start card appears once per colony. The guide sits under vanilla's learning helper and ticks topics off from game state. Not covered by a real object: no guest bed or venue sign exists in this build yet, so those two paths are tested only through hooks. The 1.6/1.5 builds were not verified. Screenshots from a rendering run show the settings pages, difficulty page, first-start card and guide panel as intended, apart from the small layout fixes already made.
implemented: Main tab HH_MainTab (worker hides the button until venues, bank account, guests via Inn, GuestBedProbe or UsageProbes say the mod is used; sticky ui.used flag), window with page list and header buttons
Overview page: guests here, income today (journal inflows to colony:till, net-per-day fallback), yesterday, income by source, bank balance, venues, hooks for other modules
Guests page: sortable table with portrait, faction, stay, mood bar, satisfaction bar, budget left, spent, wing and leaves-in. Click a row to jump to the guest. Rows are cached and culled
Guest ITab (ITab_HH_Guest) on all humanlike races: stay info, satisfaction with last 8 reasons, budget, Basics/Accompany/Recruit via GuestInfo.Handling, extension hook for other modules

Settings window installed through HearthMod.SettingsWindowOverride: this-save/template switch, Modules page (with Underworld Discover/On/Off and content intensity), Difficulty, General, one page per module with settings, Diagnosis, About. Global search, nerd toggle, reset module, save colony as template, apply template

Own row drawer (SettingRowUI) that edits an explicit profile, so the template can be edited while a game runs. It has descriptions, free entry with technical-limit messages, reset and a beyond-slider marker

Difficulty page and Dialog_HostingDifficulty: 7 named tier chips, 0-500 percent slider, feel text, warnings, live calculator with 16 rows from KONZEPT 9.2, consequence ladder from 9.4 and the 9.1 special switches as core.* settings. Registered core.consequenceStage, core.researchCost and core.upkeep with tier anchors

Diagnosis page: versions, module state with Resume, caretaker checks with fix counts, patch failures, module Diagnosis lines, last 60 log lines, Copy diagnosis to clipboard, Prepare removal (runs each module's PrepareRemoval and shows the report)

First-start card: 4 presets, module checkboxes, Underworld choice, difficulty and tutorial level, use-for-all-future-games (copies into the template without progress flags), header art area, trigger from tick 120, mod-joined-colony variant, silent template when the card is off

Guide: GuideTopicDef in XML (4 topics), GuideChecks registry, GuideState with sticky completion, panel under vanilla's learning helper via Tutor.TutorOnGUI postfix, right-click hides (core.guide off), topics fold after the first save per tutorial mode, Done group after a day, max 3 topics open

Storyteller page line (postfix on Page_SelectStoryteller.DoWindowContents) plus a Hosting difficulty button; the choice is held in a pending profile and applied to the new colony in OnGameStarted, leaving the template untouched
Style stub settings (core.houseStyle, core.keepBuiltStyle) and the English Keyed file HH_UI.xml (316 keys) generated by tools/gen_ui_keyed.py, which also checks every static key used in code
Tests: ui.windows, ui.firstcard, ui.guide, ui.tab, ui.calc, ui.settings, ui.diag (151 checks together)
not_done: Real guest-bed and venue-sign visibility in the ui.tab test: no such comp or def exists in this build. The path is covered through HearthUI.GuestBedProbe and UsageProbes, and the test notes the skip
Concierge tips, renown stars and a handbook (?) button: only hooks exist (HearthUI.RenownLine, OverviewSections). The content belongs to other modules
Arrest / Execute / Send away measures in the Guest tab: they depend on Inn module rules. GuestTabSections is the hook
Full 9.3 economic model (D value, Monte Carlo, balance badges): only the key numbers, ladder and warnings are shown
Real PawnColumnDef table (Numbers compatibility) and grouping by faction on the guests page: it is a custom cached table instead
Texture art for UI/HH/UI/MainTab and CardHeader: placeholders only, nothing committed under Common/Textures

Verification of 1.6/1.5 builds: not verified. A multi-version build errors with duplicate TargetFrameworkAttribute in Hearth.Core/obj; the error lists no UI file, I did not diagnose the cause, and the 1.7 build is fine. #if RW17 is used for the world-view check

contract_requests: None required. Optional for the Inn module: set HearthUI.GuestBedProbe = map => anyGuestBed(map) so the tab and the guide step see guest beds

Optional for other modules: register tier-driven settings under the keys the calculator looks up (inn.guestMoney, inn.priceTolerance, inn.arrivalRate, inn.expectation, inn.trouble, casino.slotEdge, bank.interestM, bank.defaultFactor, bank.collectionStage, insurance.loading, insurance.salesPressure, casino.addictionChance, casino.detection). Otherwise the calculator shows the 9.2 reference value

Modules should read the special switches (core.neverDie, core.noHostile, core.infiniteMoney, core.picky, core.feuding, core.mandatory, core.strictInspectors, core.realConsequences, core.ironBank, core.noResearchGating, core.peacefulUnderworld, core.perfMode, core.showMath), core.consequenceStage, core.researchCost and core.upkeep from HSettings
Source/build.sh prints only the tail of error lines because its sed strips them; run dotnet build directly to see messages (foundation file, not changed)
integration_notes: Namespace is Hearth.Shell, not Hearth.UI: a namespace Hearth.UI would hide Verse's UI class for every Hearth.* namespace and break UI.screenWidth. GuideTopicDef and GuideStep are in namespace Hearth, so XML uses <Hearth.GuideTopicDef>
UiModule is a HearthModuleBase with Id Core. Another Core module object would run alongside it

Public hooks in Hearth.Shell.HearthUI: GuestBedProbe, UsageProbes, RenownLine, AddOverviewSection, AddGuestTabSection, InvalidateUsage. GuideChecks.Register adds guide conditions; GuestsPage, UiState and UiStyle are public
Guide, tutorial level and tab-used state are stored as ui.* keys in HearthProfile.Store (class UiState). There is no component of my own, and the keys are stripped when copying to the template

Harmony patch classes: Tutor.TutorOnGUI postfix, GameDataSaveLoader.SaveGame postfix, Page_SelectStoryteller.DoWindowContents and PreOpen postfixes. All are skipped and logged by the foundation if a target is missing
MainButtonDef HH_MainTab uses order 85 with icon UI/HH/UI/MainTab. Because an icon is set, the bar shows the icon only, without text

The special switches and tier values are registered by the UI module under category 'Special switches' / 'Difficulty'. Registering the same key elsewhere is harmless because HSettings.Add keeps the first one
ui.windows creates a vanilla visitor group via IncidentDefOf.VisitorGroup. Without the Inn module these visitors act as guests
Screenshots for visual checks: run the suites with HH_UI_SHOTS=<dir> set in the environment
textures: UI/HH/UI/MainTab: icon of the MainButtonDef (Texture2D, drawn at 32x32 in the main bar). Placeholder created locally, not committed
UI/HH/UI/CardHeader: header art of the first-start card (Texture2D, stretched/cropped over 96 px height, about 860 px wide). Placeholder created locally, not committed
